session_read: Scoped conviction-engine demo run, Mon 2026-08-24 late session -- SMH -2.56% intraday triggers ESCALATING on its own term, VIX +4.4% to 15.79, book flat on price (equity ~$28,897, close to last known $28,498) with the same 30-name shape as 21:07's post-cascade book. This run's whole point was to prove out the same-day proposal-engine rebuild against live data end to end, not to re-run the full analytical sweep -- thesis/signal/sector-map state carried forward from the 14:45 deep review rather than fresh Stage-1 dispatch, flagged per-proposal where it matters. compute_triggers.json came back with 6 conviction_average dip candidates, 2 reentry candidates (NVDA, SKHY -- both exited in today's earlier cascade, both clearing the bar same-day), 4 profit_rotation pairs and 1 cluster_rotation pair, none forced. smith-strategist selected 5 of the strongest -- two reentries, one profit-rotation pair (MSFT->CLS), one cluster-rotation pair (AMD->TER), one catalyst-driven trim (AVGO, now carrying the Broadcom AI-financing SPV exposure alone since BX's exit) -- sizing every dollar verbatim off smith_conviction.py's suggested_size_usd, zero re-derivation, zero clamps triggered. A real bug surfaced and was fixed live: the rotation SELL legs (MSFT, AMD) were retiring themselves the instant cmd_proposals ran, because they fell through to the OLD generic cap/cluster retirement test instead of being exempted for the new paired-rotation retirement pass -- both legs of both new pairs were never over their own ATR cap to begin with, which is the whole point of a profit-booking or cluster rotation, so the old test always fired. Fixed in smith_lifecycle.py, verified by reverting and re-running clean (0 auto-retired). 11 open proposals total: the 4 legacy survivors from this morning's restatement-threshold migration, plus 7 fresh conviction-driven proposals from tonight -- first real proposals.json entries the new IDEAS/HOUSEKEEPING dashboard split has ever rendered.
